entities.summary: Paul Richard Furay is an American musician, songwriter, and retired pastor. He co-founded Buffalo Springfield, Poco, and the Souther–Hillman–Furay Band, where in all three groups he helped pioneer the country rock genre. His best known song was "Kind Woman," which he wrote for his wife, Nancy.
